preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100000 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100000 and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input must contain valid integers for n (number of cities) and m (number of roads), where 2 ≤ n ≤ 100000 and 1 ≤ m ≤ 100000. Each road must connect two distinct cities, and city indices must be between 1 and n.
The input must have exactly m + 1 lines: one for n and m, and m lines for roads.

postconditions.description: The output must be a single integer representing the minimum number of separate cities after orienting all roads unidirectionally, where 0 ≤ output ≤ n.
The output is the minimum possible number of cities with no incoming roads after optimally orienting all roads unidirectionally.
